description: The bar chart illustrates self-report accuracy for “Instilled Preferences” across two model categories, shown as grouped bars for three experimental conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories (two groups, with the right group labeled “GPT-4o-mini” and the left group shown as an unlabeled/blurred label), arranged left to right; within each category, three adjacent bars represent conditions. The vertical axis is labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)” and uses a linear scale from 0.00 to 1.00 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.25 intervals (0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00). A legend in the upper left maps colors to conditions: Control (light gray), Before Introspection Training (light blue), and After Introspection Training (dark purple). In the left category, the Control bar is approximately 0.10, the Before Introspection Training bar is about 0.55, and the After Introspection Training bar is about 0.74; each bar has a vertical error bar in gray. In the “GPT-4o-mini” category, the Control bar is approximately 0.00 (near the baseline), the Before Introspection Training bar is about 0.50, and the After Introspection Training bar is about 0.75, again each with gray error bars. The bars are grouped by category with consistent left-to-right ordering of conditions within each group, and there is no visual indication that categories are sorted by value or that any bar is specially emphasized beyond the color coding and error bars.
